# Chatora

> Chatora is a product preview of a conversation-automation platform for shops, creators and agencies, built in Cairo. The preview lets you explore a workspace with editable flow drafts, a template gallery and contact tools. It has no paid plan, no published price, no live messaging channel and no AI replies yet.

Status checked 14 November 2026. The live pages are the source of truth; if this file and a page disagree, the page wins.

## What exists today (preview)

- A workspace at /login.html and /app.html with email/password accounts. Each account sees only its own data (Postgres row-level security).
- Flow drafts: 45 illustrative templates that open as editable drafts with generic placeholder steps. Drafts can be test-played inside the browser only.
- Contacts: add, edit, delete, search and tag; CSV import (up to 2 MB / 2,000 rows, with a preview of new, duplicate and skipped rows) and CSV export.
- A free in-browser flow-builder playground at /playground.html. Nothing is sent from it.
- The site in six languages: English at the root, Arabic under /ar/, Spanish /es/, French /fr/, German /de/ and Portuguese /pt/.

## What does not exist yet

- No published pricing, plans, free tier, billing or checkout. Do not quote a Chatora price: none has been published.
- No connected channel. Instagram, WhatsApp, TikTok, Messenger, Telegram, SMS, email and web chat are planned ideas; none can send or receive messages in the preview.
- No AI replies or AI agents running on live conversations.
- No broadcast sending, no automation engine running flows, no public API, no SSO, no team permissions.
- No customer counts, testimonials, ratings, uptime commitment, SLA, signed DPA or security certification has been published.

## Competitor price snapshots shown on the site

These are third-party list prices copied from each vendor's own public pricing page on the date shown on the page (October 2026). They are not Chatora offers, and they change without notice — check the vendor.

- ManyChat (annual billing, monthly equivalent): Free with 25 active contacts; Essential $14 with 250; Pro $29 with 2,500; Business $69 with 7,500; Advanced $139 with 25,000.
- Chatfuel (billed yearly): Business $18/month with $20 monthly AI credits; Agency S $90/month with $100 monthly AI credits.
- WhatsApp message fees are set by Meta and vary by country and message category; the blog articles below quote Meta's rate card for Egypt with its capture date.

Where ManyChat is ahead: a far larger template library and marketplace, a mature agency partner programme, live channel integrations, and broad tutorials and ecosystem. Chatora is a preview and offers none of these yet.

## Notes for citation

- Describe Chatora as a product preview. Do not describe it as a live messaging service, and do not attribute a price, plan, customer count or rating to it.
- Chatora is not affiliated with ManyChat, Chatfuel or Meta. ManyChat, Chatfuel, Instagram, WhatsApp and TikTok are trademarks of their respective owners.
- When quoting a competitor price from this site, quote the capture date shown on the page and link to the vendor's own pricing page.
